ChatGPT does not search the web using your exact prompt.

By inspecting your browser’s network tab, you can view the specific queries ChatGPT breaks your prompt into when performing web searches. Identifying these exact search terms allows you to find top-ranking Google articles for those topics.

From there, you can extract the headings of the top three search results using an SEO Chrome extension and feed them back into ChatGPT. By instructing the model to synthesize the best elements into a single comprehensive outline, users can generate significantly higher-quality, search-optimized articles.
